An '''S-Thread Projection Crystal''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] and a component used in [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]]. [[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav's]] [[XXt-26 S-thread tracker]] had one of the crystals installed into the device.<ref name="EGWT" />
